49:1: O you who believe, do not go ahead of Allah and His Messenger, and beware of Allah; surely Allah is Hearing, Knowing.
49:2: O you who believe, do not raise your voices above the voice of the prophet, and do not speak loudly to him as you speak openly to one another, lest your deeds go to waste while you do not realize.
49:3: Surely those who lower their voices in the presence of the Messenger of Allah, those are the ones whose hearts Allah has tested for taqwa.
49:4: Surely most of those who call out to you from behind the chambers do not reason.
49:5: And if they had been patient until you came out to them, it would certainly have been better for them. And Allah is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.
49:6: O you who believe, if a fasiq brings you news, investigate it, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and then become regretful over what you have done.
49:7: Know that among you is the Messenger of Allah. If he were to obey you in many a matter, you would certainly fall into hardship. But Allah endeared faith to you and beautified it in your hearts, and made disbelief, wickedness, and defiance hateful to you. Those are the very ones who are rightly guided.
49:8: A grace and a favor from Allah; and Allah is Knowing, Wise.
49:9: And if two groups among the believers fight with each other, reconcile between them. But if one of them transgresses against the other, fight against the one that transgresses until it returns to the command of Allah. If it returns, reconcile between them with justice and act justly. Surely Allah loves those who act justly.
49:10: The believers are only brothers; so reconcile between your two brothers and beware of Allah so that you may receive mercy.
49:11: O you who believe, let not a group ridicule another group, perhaps they are better than them, nor let women ridicule other women, perhaps they are better than them; and do not defame one another, and do not call one another by offensive nicknames; an evil designation is wickedness after faith, and whoever does not repent, then those are the very ones who are wrongdoers.
49:12: O you who believe, avoid much of suspicion; indeed, some suspicion is sin. And do not spy, and do not backbite one another. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother? You have detested it. And beware of Allah. Surely Allah is Accepting of repentance, Merciful.
49:13: O mankind, surely We created you from a male and a female, and made you into peoples and tribes that you may get to know one another. Surely the most honorable of you in the sight of Allah is the most observant of taqwa among you. Surely Allah is Knowing, Aware.
49:14: The Bedouins said: 'We have believed.' Say: 'You have not believed, but say: "We have submitted." Faith has not yet entered your hearts. And if you obey Allah and His Messenger, He will not diminish anything from your deeds. Surely Allah is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.'
49:15: The believers are only those who have believed in Allah and His Messenger, then have not doubted, and have striven with their possessions and their lives in the cause of Allah. Those are the truthful ones.
49:16: Say: 'Are you teaching Allah your religion? While Allah knows what is in the heavens and what is on the earth, and Allah is Knower of all things.'
49:17: They consider it a favor to you that they have become Muslim. Say: 'Do not consider your Islam as a favor to me. Rather, Allah confers a favor upon you in that He has guided you to faith, if you are truthful.'
49:18: Surely Allah knows the unseen of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is Seer of what you do.
